The author's later transfer questions and worked guide were then separately checked; their review is post-disclosure, not claimed as blind.

Invalid types, sparse/incorrect-length coefficient arrays, coefficient/bound range, reversed/equal bounds and unsupported meshes refuse. Only actual branded reports serialize, with complete report equality and a separately admitted inspection method.
